# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 10 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 10

**10:1** Now there was a council of the priests, saying, "Let us make a veil for the temple of the Lord." And the priest said, "Call to me the undefiled virgins from the tribe of David." And the servants went and searched and found seven virgins. And the priest remembered the child Mary, that she was of the tribe of David and was undefiled before God. And the servants went and fetched her.

**10:2** And they brought them into the temple of the Lord, and the priest said, "Cast lots before me as to who shall weave the gold and the white and the linen and the silk and the hyacinth-blue and the scarlet and the true purple."

**10:3** And the true purple and the scarlet fell to the lot of Mary, and she took them and went to her house. Now at that time Zechariah became mute, and Samuel took his place until Zechariah spoke again. And Mary took the scarlet thread and spun it.
